Good morning team,

We're entering the final consolidation window for Q3. Attached is the working commit spreadsheet (Commit_List_Q3_ACME.xlsx) with the rows we've discussed on the last two calls. Quick asks so we can get this into Finance for invoicing and forecasting: 

- Please update the "Commit Status" column (Committed / PO Received / Needs Legal / At Risk) for any rows you own by EOD Monday 9/13 PT.
- If you have a PO, add the PO number + expected invoice date in the PO column.
- For any deals where ACV or start date changed, mark the "Forecast Delta" and leave a 1‑line reason.

I'll run a consolidation pass Tue 9/14 and produce a single rollup for finance (EOQ_Consolidated_Rollup_20270914.xlsx). We'll also maintain the daily 10:00 AM PT bridge starting Monday through close — please hold 30 mins on your calendars if you're an owner.

Attachments: Commit_List_Q3_ACME.xlsx (working), Signed_SOW_v3.pdf (for rows 12–14)

Thanks — small, focused updates will make the difference here.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround. I've consolidated the inputs and produced the final rollup (EOQ_Consolidated_Rollup_20270914.xlsx) attached. Highlights and next steps: 

- Total committed ACV in rollup: $1,420,000 (includes the three training add-ons).
- Rows with PO confirmed and invoice-ready: 3, 12, 13, 14. Finance can proceed to invoice those rows on 9/20.
- Row 7 remains PO in flight; contingency: if PO not received by 9/15, mark as At Risk and move to next quarter forecast.
- Row 11 blocked on Legal appendix — Neha, please push the appendix to Legal and confirm ETA by 9/15 EOD.

Laura: can you validate the invoice routing details for the PO rows and confirm the billing contact? Once Laura confirms, I'll hand the rollup to Finance with the consolidated attachments (EOQ_Consolidated_Rollup_20270914.xlsx + Commit_List_Q3_ACME.xlsx + Signed_SOW_v3.pdf).

If anything changes before end of day Thursday 9/16, drop a one-line update in this thread and I'll re-run the rollup. Otherwise I'll mark this as closed and move the committed rows into the invoices queue.

Thanks — team execution on the small asks paid off here.
